text:
maria: Hey all — opened PR #4826: add address fields to user_profile + migration/backfill. Can someone from DB team glance at the migration plan? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4826

maria: ```sql
-- migrations/20260317_add_address_to_user_profile.sql
ALTER TABLE user_profile ADD COLUMN address_line1 TEXT;
ALTER TABLE user_profile ADD COLUMN address_line2 TEXT;
ALTER TABLE user_profile ADD COLUMN postal_code VARCHAR(12);
```

sahil: Any downtime or table locks?

maria: No full downtime expected. ADD COLUMN is online on Postgres but backfill could cause bloat. Plan: backfill with a k8s job in small batches (10k rows/tx), VACUUM after.

dbadmin-jay: Please post the backfill job spec + expected duration. Also: if you plan to add constraints later, use `NOT VALID` then `VALIDATE CONSTRAINT`. For indexes, use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`.

anna: Can you add a migration test that runs the migration + rollback path on CI (pg 12 and pg 15)? Also include a lightweight data check to ensure no NULL unexpected values.

jen: Add this to the runbook with explicit rollback steps (how to drop columns, how to revert the backfill). FYI I'll be oncall during prod deploy window.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: Prod deploy scheduled 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC — merges after 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC will be included.

maria: Thanks all — I'll: 1) add the staging backfill job spec to the PR, 2) add migration tests to CI, 3) update runbook with rollback steps and expected timing. Tagging @dbadmin-jay and @anna for approvals.

sahil: I can run a small canary backfill on staging tonight if you push the job.

maria: Awesome — pushed staging job. TY!

anna: LGTM :thumbsup: once tests and runbook are in.

dbadmin-jay: Reviewed the SQL — fine with the plan after you add the job spec and the concurrent index note. Approve once those are in.

maria: Will wait for both approvals then merge before the freeze window. Cheers.
